description: This file defines the PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_TargetBlank', which adds target="_blank" to outbound links in HTML content. It contains methods for transforming link attributes based on URL analysis.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_TargetBlank
classes.description: A class responsible for adding target="_blank" to outbound links during HTML purification, based on URL analysis.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the parser object used to analyze URLs.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms link attributes by adding target="_blank" if the URL is external and considered non-benign.
